tokens.name: flour
tokens.usage: Page background on both sites. The default ground for every text colour.

tokens.name: flour-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, sheets, the admin order row. Text on flour-raised uses ink, ink-muted or any tone's text colour.

tokens.name: flour-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset areas: image placeholders, the Collected badge, selected-but-quiet rows, the admin side-panel ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between list rows. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, toggles, secondary buttons and date tiles: 3.7:1 on flour, 4.1:1 on flour-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on flour (13.9:1), flour-raised, flour-sunk, wheat and every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, metadata; on flour (6.2:1), flour-raised and flour-sunk (5.6:1).

tokens.name: crust
tokens.usage: The one brand colour for action: primary buttons, selected date, toggle on, links. As text on flour (5.9:1), flour-raised and crust-soft (5.2:1).

tokens.name: crust-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of crust fills.

tokens.name: crust-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind crust text: the selected choice card, the cart summary bar.

tokens.name: on-crust
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a crust or crust-deep fill (6.5:1).

tokens.name: wheat
tokens.usage: Warm accent. Decorative fills only (cover, dividers, the Unpaid label fill with ink text at 8.3:1). Never text.

tokens.name: wheat-soft
tokens.usage: The Placed badge and the generation-note highlight in the admin list.

tokens.name: wheat-ink
tokens.usage: Text on wheat-soft (6.8:1): the Placed badge label, generation-note copy.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Ready and Paid. Filled with on-sage text for the Ready badge (6.5:1); as text on flour, flour-raised and sage-soft (5.3:1).

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind sage text: the Paid label.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text on a sage fill.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Cancelled, errors, destructive actions. As text on flour (6.4:1), flour-raised and brick-soft (5.6:1). Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: brick-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brick text: the Cancelled badge, the error field background.

tokens.name: delft
tokens.usage: The Recurring label and keyboard focus. As text on flour (6.9:1), flour-raised and delft-soft (6.2:1).

tokens.name: delft-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind delft text: the Recurring label.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus-ring colour — an alias of delft so it never reads as an action or a status.

groups.name: Customer — display
groups.note: Bitter, a sturdy slab serif: stamped flour-sack lettering, not a boutique script. Headings and product names only.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: the screen's name.

styles.name: product-name
styles.usage: Product names on cards and in the cart.

groups.name: Customer — text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything people read or type: letters like 0/O and 1/l/I are unmistakable, which matters for order numbers and phone numbers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ready from 7am on the day you choose.
styles.usage: Default text. Never smaller on the customer site except caption.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, button labels, field labels.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices and totals. Use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, metadata, badge text. The smallest size on either site.

groups.name: Admin — counter
groups.note: Tablet at arm's length, busy hands, bright shop light. Nothing under 16px; the order number is the biggest thing on a row because it is read aloud.

styles.name: admin-title
styles.usage: Screen title and the pickup-date group heading.

styles.name: admin-order-number
styles.usage: The order number on every row and in the detail panel.

styles.name: admin-caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and secondary details. The floor for admin text.

spacing.note: 4px base. Customer screens mostly use 12–24; the admin steps up one notch (20–32).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; card gaps on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Admin row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile; admin card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on the admin; admin page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of page, above a screen title.

radius.note: Softened corners, like a hand-cut loaf tin — never sharp, never bubbly. Full rounding is reserved for status badges and the toggle.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges' square cousins: payment labels, the Recurring label, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, date tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the admin order row.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges and the toggle track only.

shadow.note: Low and warm (ink-tinted, not black). Borders do most of the work.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Product cards and the admin order row at rest. Soft and close, like paper on a bench.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the product modal, the admin side panel.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px flour gap then 3px solid delft (6.9:1 on flour).

size.note: Control heights and tap targets per context. Components read these through data-context.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Customer site: height of buttons, inputs, steppers and date tiles' minimum tap edge.

tokens.name: control-h-admin
tokens.usage: Admin: height of every button, input, toggle row and filter.

tokens.name: action-h-admin
tokens.usage: Admin: the Ready and Collected buttons on an order row — the most-pressed buttons in the system.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target on the customer site (icon buttons, stepper +/-).

tokens.name: tap-min-admin
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target on the admin.
